Comment.Language: The Greek hymn Ioudac O Paranomoc is chanted while the deacons are going “backwards” (clockwise) around an empty chair, symbolizing the Judas’ empty bishopric. Some rites call for placing an upside-down chair, symbolizing the broken law. This hymn is for Judas’ reprimand:

Text.Language: With silver, you have sold Christ to the Jews, who have broken the law.
بالفضة بعت المسيح لليهود مخالفي الناموس.
I~de paranomi e~pilabou meni ton <~ricton: c~taurw p~roc /~lwcan en tw k~raniw~ topw.
The Law opposers took Christ and nailed Him on the Cross at the place of Cranium.
فأما مخالفو الناموس فأخذوا المسيح وسمروه علي الصليب في موضع الاقرانيون.
Barabban ton kata kriton a~pelucan auton ton k~rit/n: ke decont/n ectaurwca
Barabas the condemned thief was set free and the Master, the Judge they crucified.
باراباس اللص المدان أطلقوه والسيد الديان صلبوه
Ic t/n n~leuran lon,/n e~pi ye~nt/c: ke wc l/ct/n xulw p~roc/~lwcan e~y/kan: en m~n/miw~ o~ ektou tavou e~girac ton Lazaron:
They thrust a spear in Your side, and as a thief they nailed You on the Cross. They laid You in a tomb, O You, Who raised Lazarus from the tomb.
في جنبك وضعوا حربة ومثل لص سمروك علي خشبة ووضعوك في قبر يامن أقام لعازر من القبر.
Wcper gar I~wnac t~ric/~merac e~ mipen: en kilia~ tou k/touc outwc ke cwr /~man: t~ric /~merac e~minen: meta twn teyn/kotwnton tavon ec vragicanto
For as Jonah stayed three days inside the whale’s belly, also our Savior stayed three days. After He died, they sealed the tomb.
لأنه كما مكث يونان ثلاثة أيام في بطن الحوت هكذا مخلصنا أقام ثلاثة أيام: بعد أن مات ختموا القبر.
Ontwc a~nect/ ke ouk egnwcan ctratia~ w~te o~ntwcegeryic o~ Cwt/r tou kocmou o~ paywn ke a~nactac dia~ tou genoc /~mwn Kurie~ doxaci: A~m/n.
Truly He rose but the soldiers were not aware that truly the Savior of the world has risen. He Who suffered and died for our sake, O Lord, glory be to You. Amen.
بالحقيقة قام والجند لم يعلموا أنه حقا نهض مخلص العالم الذي تألم وقام لأجل جنسنا. يارب المجد لك. أمين.
